name: Dr. Rahul Yadav
bio: I am a psychiatrist with 8 years of experience in psychiatry. He specializes in mood disorders, addiction, and stress-related conditions. His compassionate approach integrates evidence-based therapies with a focus on young adult mental health and long-term recovery.

name: Ms. Diksha Joshi
qualification: Ph.D. Scholar, M.Sc. in Clinical Psychology
bio: I am a counselling psychologist with over 3 years of experience. I focus on anxiety, depression, and stress management using an eclectic therapeutic approach. I am  empathetic, non-judgmental, and supportive.and active listener ,I help my clients to overcome their past issues and regain their ability to face challenges in future. With the help of counselling, I improve their quality of life and I work with children and adults.

name: Dr. Akriti Jaiswal
bio: I am a psychiatrist with 3 years of experience at Delhi Government Hospital. She specializes in juvenile psychiatry and de-addiction, addressing the emotional and rehabilitation needs of young individuals through evidence-based care.

name: Dr. Richa Trivedi
bio: I am a consultant psychiatrist experienced in treating depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, and addiction disorders. She provides a patient-centered approach emphasizing recovery, resilience, and overall mental wellness.

name: Ms. Sheenu Chandna
bio: I am a clinical psychologist with more than 5 years of experience. I use an eclectic, evidence-based approach in treating anxiety, depression, stress, and OCD. Her sessions provide a safe, non-judgmental space for personal growth and healing.

name: Dr. Sakshi Saini
bio: I am a clinical psychologist with over 2 years of experience. I provide psychotherapy, psychological evaluations, and life-skills workshops for clients with mood disorders, anxiety, OCD, and behavioral issues.

name: Dr. Rachana Maurya
bio: I am a rehabilitation and clinical psychologist specializing in trauma recovery and psychometric testing. She has helped numerous individuals rebuild confidence and emotional balance through trauma-focused therapies.

name: Dr. Sanjina Bose
qualification: M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology (RCI), M.A. Psychology (TISS)
bio: I am a clinical psychologist with over 5 years of experience specializing in psychodiagnostic assessments and third-wave therapies. I integrate CBT and mindfulness techniques to provide tailored interventions for children, adults, and geriatric clients.

name: Dr. RP Singh
bio: I am a senior consultant physician with over 44 years of experience (41 years as a specialist). I have extensive expertise in diabetes management, skin allergies, viral fever treatment, and insulin-free therapy.
